The '''Southern Lava Falls''' was a large lavafall located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The movement of [[Magma/Legends|lava]] of these falls was known to bring up rare [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and metals to the surface where they could be easily collected by [[Mining/Legends|miners]].<ref name="SWG:TMFM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Southern Lava Falls was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Southern Lava Falls was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TMFM" />
